bible.q: Name the place: “Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of ____! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.”
bible.explain: Psalm 14:7 — “Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of ____, far or near.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 48:24 — “And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.”

bible.q: Name the place: “When Pilate heard of ____, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.”
bible.explain: Luke 23:6 — “When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about ____.”
bible.explain: Mark 1:28 — “And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of ____.”
bible.explain: Isaiah 36:15 — “Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

bible.q: Name the place: “I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of ____ did tremble.”
bible.explain: Habakkuk 3:7 — “I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of ____ have beset me round.”
bible.explain: Psalm 22:12 — “Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Blow the trumpet in ____, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:”
bible.explain: Joel 2:15 — “Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:”

bible.q: Name the place: “And ____ is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.”
bible.explain: Isaiah 40:16 — “And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And on the morrow, when they were come from ____, he was hungry:”
bible.explain: Mark 11:12 — “And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:”

bible.q: Name the place: “And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and ____ shall fall by a mighty one.”
bible.explain: Isaiah 10:34 — “And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And I have seen folly in the prophets of ____; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 23:13 — “And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And upon all the ships of ____, and upon all pleasant pictures.”
bible.explain: Isaiah 2:16 — “And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Because the LORD hath spoiled ____, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 51:55 — “Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:”

bible.q: Name the place: “And their border was toward ____, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,”
bible.explain: Joshua 19:18 — “And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,”

bible.q: Name the place: “And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from ____ to this place.”
bible.explain: Luke 23:5 — “And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.”

bible.q: Name the place: “____ shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.”
bible.explain: Isaiah 1:27 — “Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at ____ alone;”
bible.explain: 1 Thessalonians 3:1 — “Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;”

bible.q: Name the place: “Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into ____, and there shall they see me.”
bible.explain: Matthew 28:10 — “Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.”

bible.q: Name the place: “As I live, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as ____ by the sea, so shall he come.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 46:18 — “As I live, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.”

bible.q: Name the place: “I have likened the daughter of ____ to a comely and delicate woman.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 6:2 — “I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand ____, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.”
bible.explain: Joshua 6:2 — “And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.”

bible.q: Name the place: “So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of ____ to Riblah.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 52:26 — “So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for ____: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 51:48 — “Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.”

bible.q: Name the place: “For the cry is gone round about the borders of ____; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.”
bible.explain: Isaiah 15:8 — “For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate ____.”
bible.explain: Psalm 129:5 — “Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Erastus abode at ____: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.”
bible.explain: 2 Timothy 4:20 — “Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.”

bible.q: Name the place: “But after I am risen again, I will go before you into ____.”
bible.explain: Matthew 26:32 — “But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.”

bible.q: Name the place: “For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto ____; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.”
bible.explain: 2 Timothy 4:10 — “For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And thou, ____, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.”
bible.explain: Luke 10:15 — “And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Baldness is come upon ____; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 47:5 — “Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?”

bible.q: Name the place: “Now ____ was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.”
bible.explain: Joshua 6:1 — “Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into ____.”
bible.explain: Luke 7:1 — “Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And when he heard that it was Jesus of ____, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.”
bible.explain: Mark 10:47 — “And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Let mount ____ rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.”
bible.explain: Psalm 48:11 — “Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.”

bible.q: Name the place: “But when Peter was come to ____, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.”
bible.explain: Galatians 2:11 — “But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And he led them out as far as to ____, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.”
bible.explain: Luke 24:50 — “And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of ____? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.”
bible.explain: John 1:46 — “And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon ____.”
bible.explain: Micah 4:11 — “Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And the women also, which came with him from ____, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.”
bible.explain: Luke 23:55 — “And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Against ____ thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 48:1 — “Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Then let them which be in ____ flee into the mountains:”
bible.explain: Matthew 24:16 — “Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:”

bible.q: Name the place: “Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of ____, the son of Joseph.”
bible.explain: John 1:45 — “Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon ____: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.”
bible.explain: Psalm 102:13 — “Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to ____ westward, and to Shihor-libnath;”
bible.explain: Joshua 19:26 — “And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;”

bible.q: Name the place: “And he left them, and went out of the city into ____; and he lodged there.”
bible.explain: Matthew 21:17 — “And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at ____, with the bishops and deacons:”
bible.explain: Philippians 1:1 — “Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:”

bible.q: Name the place: “Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this ____ on dry land.”
bible.explain: Joshua 4:22 — “Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.”

bible.q: Name the place: “So that he forsook the tabernacle of ____, the tent which he placed among men;”
bible.explain: Psalm 78:60 — “So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;”

bible.q: Name the place: “In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of ____,”
bible.explain: Matthew 3:1 — “In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,”

bible.q: Name the place: “Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into ____ again.”
bible.explain: John 11:7 — “Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of ____, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,”
bible.explain: Isaiah 9:9 — “And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,”

bible.q: Name the place: “The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of ____, one;”
bible.explain: Joshua 12:23 — “The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;”

bible.q: Name the place: “____ is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 48:4 — “Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Open thy doors, O ____, that the fire may devour thy cedars.”
bible.explain: Zechariah 11:1 — “Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of ____, where David was?”
bible.explain: John 7:42 — “Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?”

bible.q: Name the place: “Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of ____, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.”
bible.explain: John 11:1 — “Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh ____ for an inheritance.”
bible.explain: Joshua 14:13 — “And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And Joshua cast lots for them in ____ before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.”
bible.explain: Joshua 18:10 — “And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Moreover I will cause to cease in ____, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 48:35 — “Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Thou breakest the ships of ____ with an east wind.”
bible.explain: Psalm 48:7 — “Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.”

bible.q: Name the place: “____ is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;”
bible.explain: Psalm 108:8 — “Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;”

bible.q: Name the place: “Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up ____ into his mouth.”
bible.explain: Job 40:23 — “Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of ____:”
bible.explain: Isaiah 37:21 — “Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:”

bible.q: Name the place: “So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of ____ warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.”
bible.explain: Isaiah 37:8 — “So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.”

bible.q: Name the place: “He maketh them also to skip like a calf; ____ and Sirion like a young unicorn.”
bible.explain: Psalm 29:6 — “He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of ____: there is no more strength.”
bible.explain: Isaiah 23:10 — “Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.”

bible.q: Name the place: “These things were done in Bethabara beyond ____, where John was baptizing.”
bible.explain: John 1:28 — “These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.”

bible.q: Name the place: “What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou ____, that thou wast driven back?”
bible.explain: Psalm 114:5 — “What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?”

bible.q: Name the place: “So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in ____ and Achaia.”
bible.explain: 1 Thessalonians 1:7 — “So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.”

bible.q: Name the place: “They made a calf in ____, and worshipped the molten image.”
bible.explain: Psalm 106:19 — “They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And the south, and the plain of the valley of ____, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.”
bible.explain: Deuteronomy 34:3 — “And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into ____.”
bible.explain: Joshua 3:11 — “Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.”

bible.q: Name the place: “But, when he was in ____, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.”
bible.explain: 2 Timothy 1:17 — “But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.”

bible.q: Name the place: “To all that be in ____, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.”
bible.explain: Romans 1:7 — “To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.”

bible.q: Name the place: “When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to ____, seeking for Jesus.”
bible.explain: John 6:24 — “When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.”

bible.q: Name the place: “They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; ____ is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.”
bible.explain: Isaiah 10:29 — “They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.”

bible.q: Name the place: “So Joshua ascended from ____, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.”
bible.explain: Joshua 10:7 — “So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Then will I make this house like ____, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 26:6 — “Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.”

bible.q: Name the place: “____ therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.”
bible.explain: Joshua 14:14 — “Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And I will kindle a fire in the wall of ____, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.”
bible.explain: Jeremiah 49:27 — “And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to ____.”
bible.explain: Joshua 10:43 — “And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.”

bible.q: Name the place: “The king of ____, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;”
bible.explain: Joshua 12:9 — “The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;”

bible.q: Name the place: “And went away again beyond ____ into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.”
bible.explain: John 10:40 — “And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto ____; and they fought against it:”
bible.explain: Joshua 10:36 — “And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:”

bible.q: Name the place: “O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of ____, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.”
bible.explain: Psalm 42:6 — “O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.”

bible.q: Name the place: “And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward ____. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.”
bible.explain: John 6:17 — “And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.”

bible.q: Name the place: “Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at ____, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:”
bible.explain: Ephesians 1:1 — “Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:”

bible.q: Name the place: “The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in ____, in the holy place.”
bible.explain: Psalm 68:17 — “The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.”

bible.q: Name the place: “The Lord said, I will bring again from ____, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:”
bible.explain: Psalm 68:22 — “The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:”

verse.q: “I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my ____: my God; in him will I trust.”
verse.explain: Psalm 91:2 — “I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

verse.q: “Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by ____ and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.”
verse.explain: Philippians 4:6 — “Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.”

verse.q: “For God hath not given us the ____ of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.”
verse.explain: 2 Timothy 1:7 — “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.”

verse.q: “Many are the afflictions of the ____: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.”
verse.explain: Psalm 34:19 — “Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.”

verse.q: “God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in ____.”
verse.explain: John 4:24 — “God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.”

verse.q: “Glory to God in the highest, and on ____ peace, good will toward men.”
verse.explain: Luke 2:14 — “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.”

verse.q: “Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own ____.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 3:5 — “Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.”

verse.q: “Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 46:10 — “Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.”

verse.q: “In every thing ____ thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.”
verse.explain: 1 Thessalonians 5:18 — “In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.”

verse.q: “The name of the LORD is a strong ____: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 18:10 — “The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.”

verse.q: “Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the ____, but by me.”
verse.explain: John 14:6 — “Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.”

verse.q: “Blessed are the pure in ____: for they shall see God.”
verse.explain: Matthew 5:8 — “Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.”

verse.q: “For the wages of sin is ____; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.”
verse.explain: Romans 6:23 — “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.”

verse.q: “The heavens declare the ____ of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.”
verse.explain: Psalm 19:1 — “The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.”

verse.q: “And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine ____, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.”
verse.explain: Deuteronomy 6:5 — “And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.”

verse.q: “Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy ____ shall be established.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 16:3 — “Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.”

verse.q: “Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the ____ to be moved.”
verse.explain: Psalm 55:22 — “Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.”

verse.q: “But my God shall supply all your need according to his ____ in glory by Christ Jesus.”
verse.explain: Philippians 4:19 — “But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.”

verse.q: “For the LORD thy God is a consuming ____, even a jealous God.”
verse.explain: Deuteronomy 4:24 — “For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.”

verse.q: “My help cometh from the LORD, which made ____ and earth.”
verse.explain: Psalm 121:2 — “My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.”

verse.q: “Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose ____ the LORD is.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 17:7 — “Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.”

verse.q: “It is of the LORD'S ____ that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.”
verse.explain: Lamentations 3:22 — “It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.”

verse.q: “Arise, shine; for thy ____ is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 60:1 — “Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.”

verse.q: “And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath ____ you.”
verse.explain: Ephesians 4:32 — “And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.”

verse.q: “The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is ____.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 9:10 — “The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.”

verse.q: “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all ____: is there any thing too hard for me?”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 32:27 — “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?”

verse.q: “Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to ____, and for ever.”
verse.explain: Hebrews 13:8 — “Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.”

verse.q: “But thanks be to God, which giveth us the ____ through our Lord Jesus Christ.”
verse.explain: 1 Corinthians 15:57 — “But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.”

verse.q: “Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a ____ soweth, that shall he also reap.”
verse.explain: Galatians 6:7 — “Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.”

verse.q: “Is not my ____ like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 23:29 — “Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?”

verse.q: “Let every thing that hath ____ praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.”
verse.explain: Psalm 150:6 — “Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.”

verse.q: “For to me to ____ is Christ, and to die is gain.”
verse.explain: Philippians 1:21 — “For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.”

verse.q: “Bless the LORD, O my ____: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.”
verse.explain: Psalm 103:1 — “Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.”

verse.q: “The ____ is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.”
verse.explain: Psalm 24:1 — “The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.”

verse.q: “Put on the ____ armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.”
verse.explain: Ephesians 6:11 — “Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.”

verse.q: “The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the ____ of our God shall stand for ever.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 40:8 — “The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.”

verse.q: “If ye shall ask any thing in my ____, I will do it.”
verse.explain: John 14:14 — “If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.”

verse.q: “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right ____; but it shall not come nigh thee.”
verse.explain: Psalm 91:7 — “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.”

verse.q: “And he saith unto them, ____ me, and I will make you fishers of men.”
verse.explain: Matthew 4:19 — “And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.”

verse.q: “He sent his ____, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.”
verse.explain: Psalm 107:20 — “He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.”

verse.q: “Watch ye, stand fast in the ____, quit you like men, be strong.”
verse.explain: 1 Corinthians 16:13 — “Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.”

verse.q: “Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right ____ within me.”
verse.explain: Psalm 51:10 — “Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.”

verse.q: “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his ____; and all these things shall be added unto you.”
verse.explain: Matthew 6:33 — “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.”

verse.q: “Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and ____ things, which thou knowest not.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 33:3 — “Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.”

verse.q: “So then ____ cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.”
verse.explain: Romans 10:17 — “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.”

verse.q: “Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with ____.”
verse.explain: Romans 12:21 — “Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.”

verse.q: “This is the ____ which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.”
verse.explain: Psalm 118:24 — “This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.”

verse.q: “For unto you is born this day in the ____ of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.”
verse.explain: Luke 2:11 — “For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.”

verse.q: “I will ____ thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.”
verse.explain: Psalm 139:14 — “I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.”

verse.q: “Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that ____ us.”
verse.explain: Romans 8:37 — “Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.”

verse.q: “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you ____.”
verse.explain: John 8:32 — “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”

verse.q: “Keep thy ____ with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 4:23 — “Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.”

verse.q: “If the ____ therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.”
verse.explain: John 8:36 — “If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.”

verse.q: “Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that ____.”
verse.explain: Mark 9:23 — “Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.”

verse.q: “And the peace of God, which passeth all ____, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.”
verse.explain: Philippians 4:7 — “And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.”

verse.q: “But God commendeth his ____ toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.”
verse.explain: Romans 5:8 — “But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.”

verse.q: “Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the ____ of God.”
verse.explain: Matthew 5:9 — “Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.”

verse.q: “O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the ____ that trusteth in him.”
verse.explain: Psalm 34:8 — “O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.”

verse.q: “He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is ____.”
verse.explain: 1 John 4:8 — “He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.”

verse.q: “Thou wilt keep him in perfect ____, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 26:3 — “Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.”

verse.q: “And he said unto them, Go ye into all the ____, and preach the gospel to every creature.”
verse.explain: Mark 16:15 — “And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.”

verse.q: “In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy ____.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 3:6 — “In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.”

verse.q: “And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never ____; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.”
verse.explain: John 6:35 — “And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.”

verse.q: “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the ____.”
verse.explain: Romans 8:1 — “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.”

verse.q: “I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 37:25 — “I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.”

verse.q: “Thy word have I hid in mine ____, that I might not sin against thee.”
verse.explain: Psalm 119:11 — “Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.”

verse.q: “Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the ____ of God.”
verse.explain: John 3:3 — “Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”

verse.q: “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his ____: for this is the whole duty of man.”
verse.explain: Ecclesiastes 12:13 — “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.”

verse.q: “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of ____, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 29:11 — “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.”

verse.q: “Greater ____ hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.”
verse.explain: John 15:13 — “Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.”

verse.q: “The LORD is my light and my ____; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?”
verse.explain: Psalm 27:1 — “The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?”

verse.q: “Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my ____, and my redeemer.”
verse.explain: Psalm 19:14 — “Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.”

verse.q: “I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living ____, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.”
verse.explain: Romans 12:1 — “I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.”

verse.q: “Therefore if any ____ be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.”
verse.explain: 2 Corinthians 5:17 — “Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.”

verse.q: “He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of ____ for his name's sake.”
verse.explain: Psalm 23:3 — “He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.”

verse.q: “If any of you lack ____, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.”
verse.explain: James 1:5 — “If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.”

verse.q: “Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his ____.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 27:17 — “Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.”

verse.q: “Ye are the ____ of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.”
verse.explain: Matthew 5:14 — “Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.”

verse.q: “But be ye doers of the ____, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.”
verse.explain: James 1:22 — “But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.”

verse.q: “Every man according as he purposeth in his ____, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.”
verse.explain: 2 Corinthians 9:7 — “Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.”

verse.q: “After this manner therefore pray ye: Our ____ which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.”
verse.explain: Matthew 6:9 — “After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.”

verse.q: “For the ____ of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.”
verse.explain: Luke 19:10 — “For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.”

verse.q: “Where there is no ____, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 29:18 — “Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.”

verse.q: “Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty ____ before a fall.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 16:18 — “Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.”

verse.q: “Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: ____ are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.”
verse.explain: John 20:29 — “Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.”

verse.q: “And we know that all things ____ together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.”
verse.explain: Romans 8:28 — “And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.”

verse.q: “Surely ____ and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.”
verse.explain: Psalm 23:6 — “Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.”

verse.q: “For the LORD God is a sun and ____: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.”
verse.explain: Psalm 84:11 — “For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.”

verse.q: “Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the ____.”
verse.explain: 1 John 4:4 — “Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.”

verse.q: “Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with ____: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.”
verse.explain: Psalm 100:4 — “Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.”

verse.q: “For he shall give his ____ charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.”
verse.explain: Psalm 91:11 — “For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.”

verse.q: “Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for ____ to dwell together in unity!”
verse.explain: Psalm 133:1 — “Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!”

verse.q: “Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and ____ in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.”
verse.explain: Romans 15:13 — “Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.”

verse.q: “I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 121:1 — “I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.”

verse.q: “He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 23:2 — “He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.”

verse.q: “And now abideth ____, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.”
verse.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:13 — “And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.”

verse.q: “For where two or three are gathered together in my ____, there am I in the midst of them.”
verse.explain: Matthew 18:20 — “For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.”

verse.q: “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the ____ of the Almighty.”
verse.explain: Psalm 91:1 — “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.”

verse.q: “Now ____ is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.”
verse.explain: Hebrews 11:1 — “Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.”

verse.q: “Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the ____ of his might.”
verse.explain: Ephesians 6:10 — “Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.”

verse.q: “And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the ____, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.”
verse.explain: Habakkuk 2:2 — “And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.”

verse.q: “Death and life are in the power of the ____: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 18:21 — “Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.”

verse.q: “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your ____ which is in heaven.”
verse.explain: Matthew 5:16 — “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.”

verse.q: “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a ____ unto my path.”
verse.explain: Psalm 119:105 — “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.”

verse.q: “A soft answer turneth away ____: but grievous words stir up anger.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 15:1 — “A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.”

verse.q: “So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 90:12 — “So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.”

verse.q: “Come unto me, all ye that ____ and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.”
verse.explain: Matthew 11:28 — “Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.”

verse.q: “Thou preparest a ____ before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.”
verse.explain: Psalm 23:5 — “Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.”

verse.q: “Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy ____, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.”
verse.explain: Matthew 22:37 — “Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.”

verse.q: “If we confess our sins, he is ____ and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.”
verse.explain: 1 John 1:9 — “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.”

verse.q: “Blessed are the poor in spirit: for their's is the ____ of heaven.”
verse.explain: Matthew 5:3 — “Blessed are the poor in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.”

verse.q: “And let us not be ____ in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.”
verse.explain: Galatians 6:9 — “And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.”

verse.q: “The LORD is my ____; I shall not want.”
verse.explain: Psalm 23:1 — “The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.”

verse.q: “Set your affection on things above, not on things on the ____.”
verse.explain: Colossians 3:2 — “Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.”

verse.q: “Train up a ____ in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 22:6 — “Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.”

verse.q: “Who can find a virtuous ____? for her price is far above rubies.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 31:10 — “Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.”

verse.q: “I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the ____.”
verse.explain: John 10:11 — “I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.”

verse.q: “Heaven and ____ shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.”
verse.explain: Matthew 24:35 — “Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.”

verse.q: “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth ____.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 40:29 — “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.”

verse.q: “But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by ____ alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.”
verse.explain: Matthew 4:4 — “But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.”

verse.q: “Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the ____. Amen.”
verse.explain: Matthew 28:20 — “Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.”

verse.q: “For God so loved the ____, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.”
verse.explain: John 3:16 — “For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.”

verse.q: “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual ____ in high places.”
verse.explain: Ephesians 6:12 — “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.”

verse.q: “And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his ____: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.”
verse.explain: Job 42:10 — “And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.”

verse.q: “And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all ____.”
verse.explain: Luke 2:10 — “And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.”

verse.q: “And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of ____, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.”
verse.explain: Deuteronomy 4:11 — “And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.”

verse.q: “They are new every ____: great is thy faithfulness.”
verse.explain: Lamentations 3:23 — “They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.”

verse.q: “In my Father's ____ are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.”
verse.explain: John 14:2 — “In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.”

verse.q: “They that sow in tears shall reap in ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 126:5 — “They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.”

verse.q: “Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the ____: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.”
verse.explain: Luke 10:19 — “Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.”

verse.q: “Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the ____ of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.”
verse.explain: James 1:17 — “Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.”

verse.q: “Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent ____ of a righteous man availeth much.”
verse.explain: James 5:16 — “Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.”

verse.q: “And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy ____.”
verse.explain: Acts 16:31 — “And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.”

verse.q: “A ____ commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.”
verse.explain: John 13:34 — “A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.”

verse.q: “Also I heard the ____ of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 6:8 — “Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.”

verse.q: “Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a ____; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 7:14 — “Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.”

verse.q: “In the beginning God created the ____ and the earth.”
verse.explain: Genesis 1:1 — “In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.”

verse.q: “But Noah found ____ in the eyes of the LORD.”
verse.explain: Genesis 6:8 — “But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.”

verse.q: “The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee ____.”
verse.explain: Numbers 6:26 — “The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.”

verse.q: “And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small ____.”
verse.explain: 1 Kings 19:12 — “And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.”

verse.q: “Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he ____ said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.”
verse.explain: Hebrews 13:5 — “Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.”

verse.q: “And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt ____: so they went both of them together.”
verse.explain: Genesis 22:8 — “And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.”

verse.q: “And they overcame him by the ____ of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.”
verse.explain: Revelation 12:11 — “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.”

verse.q: “Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the ____ and the prophets.”
verse.explain: Matthew 7:12 — “Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.”

verse.q: “For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 30:5 — “For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.”

verse.q: “And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy ____? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?”
verse.explain: Genesis 4:9 — “And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?”

verse.q: “And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy ____ heareth.”
verse.explain: 1 Samuel 3:10 — “And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.”

verse.q: “Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the ____ is the evil thereof.”
verse.explain: Matthew 6:34 — “Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.”

verse.q: “There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that ____ is not made perfect in love.”
verse.explain: 1 John 4:18 — “There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.”

verse.q: “Honour thy ____ and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.”
verse.explain: Exodus 20:12 — “Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.”

verse.q: “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy ____ is truth.”
verse.explain: John 17:17 — “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.”

verse.q: “So God created ____ in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.”
verse.explain: Genesis 1:27 — “So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.”

verse.q: “I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in ____ over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.”
verse.explain: Luke 15:7 — “I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.”

verse.q: “Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, ____ that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.”
verse.explain: Mark 11:24 — “Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.”

verse.q: “Blessed is the man that walketh not in the ____ of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.”
verse.explain: Psalm 1:1 — “Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.”

verse.q: “And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for ____.”
verse.explain: Genesis 15:6 — “And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.”

verse.q: “The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your ____.”
verse.explain: Exodus 14:14 — “The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.”

verse.q: “And he answered, ____ not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.”
verse.explain: 2 Kings 6:16 — “And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.”

verse.q: “But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be ____; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.”
verse.explain: Obadiah 1:17 — “But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.”

verse.q: “And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty ____ of valour.”
verse.explain: Judges 6:12 — “And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.”

verse.q: “And the rain was upon the ____ forty days and forty nights.”
verse.explain: Genesis 7:12 — “And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.”

verse.q: “Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy ____, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.”
verse.explain: Leviticus 19:18 — “Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.”

verse.q: “Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy ____ prospereth.”
verse.explain: 3 John 1:2 — “Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.”

verse.q: “And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ____, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.”
verse.explain: Genesis 2:7 — “And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.”

verse.q: “And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee ____.”
verse.explain: Exodus 33:14 — “And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.”

verse.q: “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an ____ meet for him.”
verse.explain: Genesis 2:18 — “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.”

verse.q: “And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the ____ gave them utterance.”
verse.explain: Acts 2:4 — “And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.”

verse.q: “And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou ____ with God and with men, and hast prevailed.”
verse.explain: Genesis 32:28 — “And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.”

verse.q: “And I will put enmity between thee and the ____, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.”
verse.explain: Genesis 3:15 — “And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.”

verse.q: “Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the ____ of the LORD.”
verse.explain: Ezekiel 37:4 — “Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.”

verse.q: “And such as do wickedly against the ____ shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.”
verse.explain: Daniel 11:32 — “And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.”

verse.q: “Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his ____, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.”
verse.explain: Genesis 37:3 — “Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.”

verse.q: “For in him we ____, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.”
verse.explain: Acts 17:28 — “For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.”

verse.q: “I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a ____ between me and the earth.”
verse.explain: Genesis 9:13 — “I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.”

verse.q: “And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ____.”
verse.explain: Exodus 3:5 — “And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.”

verse.q: “Neither is there ____ in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.”
verse.explain: Acts 4:12 — “Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.”

verse.q: “Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My ____ is more than God's?”
verse.explain: Job 35:2 — “Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?”

verse.q: “Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the ____ say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.”
verse.explain: Psalm 106:48 — “Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.”

verse.q: “He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his ____ to approach unto him.”
verse.explain: Job 40:19 — “He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.”

verse.q: “The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the ____ of the LORD; the priests, the LORD'S ministers, mourn.”
verse.explain: Joel 1:9 — “The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD'S ministers, mourn.”

verse.q: “Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the ____ of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.”
verse.explain: John 6:29 — “Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.”

verse.q: “The ____ of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.”
verse.explain: Romans 16:24 — “The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.”

verse.q: “For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the ____ by measure unto him.”
verse.explain: John 3:34 — “For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.”

verse.q: “Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the ____ of God, neither indeed can be.”
verse.explain: Romans 8:7 — “Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.”

verse.q: “After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the ____ of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.”
verse.explain: John 21:1 — “After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.”

verse.q: “The ____ of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.”
verse.explain: Joel 1:1 — “The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.”

verse.q: “How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou ____ thy face from me?”
verse.explain: Psalm 13:1 — “How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?”

verse.q: “Remember, O LORD, thy tender ____ and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.”
verse.explain: Psalm 25:6 — “Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.”

verse.q: “The ____ of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 47:1 — “The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.”

verse.q: “For her sins have reached unto ____, and God hath remembered her iniquities.”
verse.explain: Revelation 18:5 — “For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.”

verse.q: “This is the ____ of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.”
verse.explain: Job 27:13 — “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.”

verse.q: “But I will declare for ever; I will ____ praises to the God of Jacob.”
verse.explain: Psalm 75:9 — “But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.”

verse.q: “Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 25:8 — “Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.”

verse.q: “After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews ____ to kill him.”
verse.explain: John 7:1 — “After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.”

verse.q: “Jesus answered and said, This ____ came not because of me, but for your sakes.”
verse.explain: John 12:30 — “Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.”

verse.q: “Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 119:137 — “Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.”

verse.q: “Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the ____ of her God.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 2:17 — “Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.”

verse.q: “My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the ____ of my heart, and my portion for ever.”
verse.explain: Psalm 73:26 — “My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.”

verse.q: “Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto ____ ready to be revealed in the last time.”
verse.explain: 1 Peter 1:5 — “Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.”

verse.q: “This thou hast seen, O LORD: ____ not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.”
verse.explain: Psalm 35:22 — “This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.”

verse.q: “The ____ of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.”
verse.explain: Psalm 104:31 — “The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.”

verse.q: “That we should be to the ____ of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.”
verse.explain: Ephesians 1:12 — “That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.”

verse.q: “I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your ____.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 43:15 — “I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.”

verse.q: “But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that ____, saith the LORD.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 12:17 — “But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.”

verse.q: “Will God hear his cry when trouble ____ upon him?”
verse.explain: Job 27:9 — “Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?”

verse.q: “The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 121:5 — “The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.”

verse.q: “The LORD knoweth the ____ of man, that they are vanity.”
verse.explain: Psalm 94:11 — “The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.”

verse.q: “The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the ____.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 3:13 — “The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.”

verse.q: “At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 76:6 — “At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.”

verse.q: “Unto him be ____ in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.”
verse.explain: Ephesians 3:21 — “Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.”

verse.q: “The ____ of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 10:22 — “The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.”

verse.q: “For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his ____.”
verse.explain: Job 27:22 — “For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.”

verse.q: “The words of the LORD are pure words: as ____ tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.”
verse.explain: Psalm 12:6 — “The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.”

verse.q: “He will bless them that ____ the LORD, both small and great.”
verse.explain: Psalm 115:13 — “He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.”

verse.q: “What ____ is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.”
verse.explain: Psalm 25:12 — “What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.”

verse.q: “For the LORD is ____, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.”
verse.explain: Psalm 96:4 — “For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.”

verse.q: “I will take the cup of ____, and call upon the name of the LORD.”
verse.explain: Psalm 116:13 — “I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.”

verse.q: “Evil men understand not ____: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 28:5 — “Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.”

verse.q: “Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy ____ is upon thy people. Selah.”
verse.explain: Psalm 3:8 — “Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.”

verse.q: “She said, No ____, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.”
verse.explain: John 8:11 — “She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.”

verse.q: “The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. ____ ye the LORD.”
verse.explain: Psalm 146:10 — “The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.”

verse.q: “It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the ____ of kings is to search out a matter.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 25:2 — “It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.”

verse.q: “For thou, LORD, art high above all the ____: thou art exalted far above all gods.”
verse.explain: Psalm 97:9 — “For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.”

verse.q: “They break in pieces thy ____, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.”
verse.explain: Psalm 94:5 — “They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.”

verse.q: “Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat ____.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 7:21 — “Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.”

verse.q: “Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her ____.”
verse.explain: Job 39:17 — “Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.”

verse.q: “Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that ____ up against thee?”
verse.explain: Psalm 139:21 — “Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?”

verse.q: “LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy ____ hill?”
verse.explain: Psalm 15:1 — “LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?”

verse.q: “The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth ____ for ever.”
verse.explain: Psalm 29:10 — “The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.”

verse.q: “Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy ____, and walk.”
verse.explain: John 5:8 — “Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.”

verse.q: “For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall ____ thee.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 25:22 — “For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.”

verse.q: “By mercy and truth ____ is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 16:6 — “By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.”

verse.q: “Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my ____: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.”
verse.explain: Psalm 27:7 — “Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.”

verse.q: “Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy ____ is a right sceptre.”
verse.explain: Psalm 45:6 — “Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.”

verse.q: “But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this ____.”
verse.explain: Joshua 23:8 — “But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.”

verse.q: “But I ____, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.”
verse.explain: John 11:22 — “But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.”

verse.q: “Jesus therefore ____ and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.”
verse.explain: John 6:43 — “Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.”

verse.q: “As keepers of a ____, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 4:17 — “As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.”

verse.q: “But our God is in the ____: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.”
verse.explain: Psalm 115:3 — “But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.”

verse.q: “The LORD shall send the rod of thy ____ out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.”
verse.explain: Psalm 110:2 — “The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.”
