verse.explain: Psalm 10:4 — “The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.”

verse.q: “A ____ of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.”
verse.explain: Psalm 68:5 — “A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.”

verse.q: “For what portion of God is there from above? and what ____ of the Almighty from on high?”
verse.explain: Job 31:2 — “For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?”

verse.q: “Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 37:24 — “Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.”

verse.q: “He that is of God heareth God's ____: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.”
verse.explain: John 8:47 — “He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.”

verse.q: “There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the ____ of the LORD, that shall stand.”
verse.explain: Proverbs 19:21 — “There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.”

verse.q: “Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 108:13 — “Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.”

verse.q: “But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in ____.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 5:16 — “But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.”

verse.q: “For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the ____ of him that was stronger than he.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 31:11 — “For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.”

verse.q: “Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the ____ with his own blood, suffered without the gate.”
verse.explain: Hebrews 13:12 — “Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.”

verse.q: “The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the ____, that this man was born there. Selah.”
verse.explain: Psalm 87:6 — “The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.”

verse.q: “Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his ____ place?”
verse.explain: Psalm 24:3 — “Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?”

verse.q: “For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 94:14 — “For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.”

verse.q: “Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the ____ of the LORD.”
verse.explain: Psalm 118:26 — “Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.”

verse.q: “For the law of the ____ of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.”
verse.explain: Romans 8:2 — “For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.”

verse.q: “Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the ____ of thy ways.”
verse.explain: Job 21:14 — “Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.”

verse.q: “For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their ____, saith the LORD.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 23:11 — “For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.”

verse.q: “The same day went Jesus out of the ____, and sat by the sea side.”
verse.explain: Matthew 13:1 — “The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.”

verse.q: “The ____ of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.”
verse.explain: Psalm 19:9 — “The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.”

verse.q: “O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the ____ of thy people?”
verse.explain: Psalm 80:4 — “O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?”

verse.q: “The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that ____ him, and delivereth them.”
verse.explain: Psalm 34:7 — “The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.”

verse.q: “Saying, God ____ forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.”
verse.explain: Psalm 71:11 — “Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.”

verse.q: “Praise ye the LORD: for it is ____ to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.”
verse.explain: Psalm 147:1 — “Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.”

verse.q: “Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the ____ of them that contend with me.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 18:19 — “Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.”

verse.q: “To execute upon them the ____ written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.”
verse.explain: Psalm 149:9 — “To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.”

verse.q: “I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 116:14 — “I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.”

verse.q: “For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy ____: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.”
verse.explain: Psalm 92:4 — “For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.”

verse.q: “For it is the day of the LORD'S ____, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 34:8 — “For it is the day of the LORD'S vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.”

verse.q: “Called of God an ____ priest after the order of Melchisedec.”
verse.explain: Hebrews 5:10 — “Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.”

verse.q: “Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a ____ captivity, and will surely cover thee.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 22:17 — “Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.”

verse.q: “Can a ____ be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?”
verse.explain: Job 22:2 — “Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?”

verse.q: “God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 47:5 — “God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.”

verse.q: “I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 40:8 — “I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.”

verse.q: “There is no ____, saith my God, to the wicked.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 57:21 — “There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.”

verse.q: “For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be ____ alive.”
verse.explain: 1 Corinthians 15:22 — “For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.”

verse.q: “The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and ____.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 33:5 — “The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.”

verse.q: “My friends scorn me: but mine ____ poureth out tears unto God.”
verse.explain: Job 16:20 — “My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.”

verse.q: “Until I ____ into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.”
verse.explain: Psalm 73:17 — “Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.”

verse.q: “But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 66:19 — “But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.”

verse.q: “LORD, what is man, that thou takest ____ of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!”
verse.explain: Psalm 144:3 — “LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!”

verse.q: “Serve the LORD with gladness: ____ before his presence with singing.”
verse.explain: Psalm 100:2 — “Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.”

verse.q: “I have stuck unto thy ____: O LORD, put me not to shame.”
verse.explain: Psalm 119:31 — “I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.”

verse.q: “The LORD reigneth; let the ____ tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.”
verse.explain: Psalm 99:1 — “The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.”

verse.q: “Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a ____ like him?”
verse.explain: Job 40:9 — “Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?”

verse.q: “Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this ____ do?”
verse.explain: John 21:21 — “Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?”

verse.q: “Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 60:12 — “Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.”

verse.q: “But your ____ have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.”
verse.explain: Deuteronomy 11:7 — “But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.”

verse.q: “The voice of rejoicing and ____ is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.”
verse.explain: Psalm 118:15 — “The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.”

verse.q: “But Jesus turning unto them said, ____ of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.”
verse.explain: Luke 23:28 — “But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.”

verse.q: “When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 102:16 — “When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.”

verse.q: “But when Jesus perceived their ____, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?”
verse.explain: Luke 5:22 — “But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?”

verse.q: “Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the ____ of the LORD our God.”
verse.explain: Psalm 20:7 — “Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.”

verse.q: “Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 71:4 — “Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.”

verse.q: “The same ____ therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.”
verse.explain: John 12:21 — “The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.”

verse.q: “Exalt the LORD our God, and ____ at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.”
verse.explain: Psalm 99:9 — “Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.”

verse.q: “I will offer to thee the ____ of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.”
verse.explain: Psalm 116:17 — “I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.”

verse.q: “Who hath directed the ____ of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught him?”
verse.explain: Isaiah 40:13 — “Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught him?”

verse.q: “James, a ____ of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.”
verse.explain: James 1:1 — “James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.”

verse.q: “Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 143:1 — “Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.”

verse.q: “Thou art my God, and I will ____ thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.”
verse.explain: Psalm 118:28 — “Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.”

verse.q: “I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if ____ come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.”
verse.explain: Galatians 2:21 — “I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.”

verse.q: “For he looked for a ____ which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.”
verse.explain: Hebrews 11:10 — “For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.”

verse.q: “Shall any teach God ____? seeing he judgeth those that are high.”
verse.explain: Job 21:22 — “Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.”

verse.q: “After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I ____.”
verse.explain: John 19:28 — “After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.”

verse.q: “Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the ____ of the LORD?”
verse.explain: Isaiah 38:22 — “Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?”

verse.q: “But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this ____ shall become a desolation.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 22:5 — “But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.”

verse.q: “I wait for the LORD, my ____ doth wait, and in his word do I hope.”
verse.explain: Psalm 130:5 — “I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.”

verse.q: “Wherewith thine ____ have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.”
verse.explain: Psalm 89:51 — “Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.”

verse.q: “Have the workers of iniquity no ____? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.”
verse.explain: Psalm 53:4 — “Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.”

verse.q: “For the wrath of man worketh not the ____ of God.”
verse.explain: James 1:20 — “For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.”

verse.q: “God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 7:11 — “God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.”

verse.q: “Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine ____: forget not the humble.”
verse.explain: Psalm 10:12 — “Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.”

verse.q: “Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in ____, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.”
verse.explain: Psalm 135:6 — “Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.”

verse.q: “Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at ____; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 13:6 — “Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.”

verse.q: “Not that any ____ hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.”
verse.explain: John 6:46 — “Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.”

verse.q: “Who knoweth not in all these that the ____ of the LORD hath wrought this?”
verse.explain: Job 12:9 — “Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?”

verse.q: “Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the ____ of God.”
verse.explain: Matthew 22:29 — “Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.”

verse.q: “For who ____ known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.”
verse.explain: 1 Corinthians 2:16 — “For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.”

verse.q: “He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and ____ from the God of his salvation.”
verse.explain: Psalm 24:5 — “He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.”

verse.q: “As with a ____ in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?”
verse.explain: Psalm 42:10 — “As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?”

verse.q: “For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee ____ on me.”
verse.explain: Romans 15:3 — “For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.”

verse.q: “Yet if any ____ suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.”
verse.explain: 1 Peter 4:16 — “Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.”

verse.q: “Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the ____ of Babylon.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 28:2 — “Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.”

verse.q: “But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the ____ of Titus for you.”
verse.explain: 2 Corinthians 8:16 — “But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.”

verse.q: “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 99:2 — “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.”

verse.q: “Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest ____ of their inventions.”
verse.explain: Psalm 99:8 — “Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.”

verse.q: “These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the ____.”
verse.explain: Revelation 11:4 — “These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.”

verse.q: “Thou lovest ____, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.”
verse.explain: Psalm 45:7 — “Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.”

verse.q: “But Jesus took him by the ____, and lifted him up; and he arose.”
verse.explain: Mark 9:27 — “But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.”

verse.q: “Yet the LORD hath not given you an ____ to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.”
verse.explain: Deuteronomy 29:4 — “Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.”

verse.q: “The LORD preserveth the simple: I was ____ low, and he helped me.”
verse.explain: Psalm 116:6 — “The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.”

verse.q: “The ____ priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.”
verse.explain: John 18:19 — “The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.”

verse.q: “Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your ____, I said, Ye are gods?”
verse.explain: John 10:34 — “Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?”

verse.q: “Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to ____ thee, saith the LORD.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 1:8 — “Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.”

verse.q: “Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 26:2 — “Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.”

verse.q: “The God and ____ of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.”
verse.explain: 2 Corinthians 11:31 — “The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.”

verse.q: “I have preached ____ in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.”
verse.explain: Psalm 40:9 — “I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.”

verse.q: “The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in ____ shall glory.”
verse.explain: Psalm 64:10 — “The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.”

verse.q: “Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine ____: wait, I say, on the LORD.”
verse.explain: Psalm 27:14 — “Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.”

verse.q: “He hath said in his ____, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.”
verse.explain: Psalm 10:11 — “He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.”

verse.q: “But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that ____ person.”
verse.explain: 1 Corinthians 5:13 — “But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.”

verse.q: “Being born again, not of corruptible ____, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.”
verse.explain: 1 Peter 1:23 — “Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.”

verse.q: “Thou therefore endure hardness, as a ____ soldier of Jesus Christ.”
verse.explain: 2 Timothy 2:3 — “Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.”

verse.q: “There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the ____ of thy countenance upon us.”
verse.explain: Psalm 4:6 — “There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.”

verse.q: “For God sent not his ____ into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.”
verse.explain: John 3:17 — “For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.”

verse.q: “He hath made his wonderful ____ to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.”
verse.explain: Psalm 111:4 — “He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.”

verse.q: “For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a ____ of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 30:5 — “For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.”

verse.q: “Teach me, O LORD, the ____ of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.”
verse.explain: Psalm 119:33 — “Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.”

verse.q: “Behold, the LORD maketh the ____ empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.”
verse.explain: Isaiah 24:1 — “Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.”

verse.q: “But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every ____ his own body.”
verse.explain: 1 Corinthians 15:38 — “But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.”

verse.q: “For Christ is the end of the law for ____ to every one that believeth.”
verse.explain: Romans 10:4 — “For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.”

verse.q: “The LORD is ____ in all his ways, and holy in all his works.”
verse.explain: Psalm 145:17 — “The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.”

verse.q: “Have ____ upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.”
verse.explain: Psalm 6:2 — “Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.”

verse.q: “Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the ____ of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.”
verse.explain: Joel 3:14 — “Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.”

verse.q: “Thy ____ is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.”
verse.explain: Psalm 36:6 — “Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.”

verse.q: “The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of ____ for multitude.”
verse.explain: Deuteronomy 1:10 — “The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.”

verse.q: “Those that be planted in the ____ of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.”
verse.explain: Psalm 92:13 — “Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.”

verse.q: “Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an ____ priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.”
verse.explain: Hebrews 6:20 — “Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.”

verse.q: “Behold, O God our ____, and look upon the face of thine anointed.”
verse.explain: Psalm 84:9 — “Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.”

verse.q: “The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy ____.”
verse.explain: Psalm 121:7 — “The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.”

verse.q: “Am I a God at ____, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 23:23 — “Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?”

verse.q: “Stand fast therefore in the ____ wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.”
verse.explain: Galatians 5:1 — “Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.”

verse.q: “Thou shalt ____ the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.”
verse.explain: Deuteronomy 6:13 — “Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.”

verse.q: “For the ____ is the LORD'S: and he is the governor among the nations.”

verse.q: “Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for ____ is comely for the upright.”
verse.explain: Psalm 33:1 — “Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.”

verse.q: “O LORD, correct me, but with ____; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.”
verse.explain: Jeremiah 10:24 — “O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.”

Finish the verse: “In the beginning God created the ____ and the earth.”
kids.explain: Genesis 1:1 — “In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “So God created ____ in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.”
kids.explain: Genesis 1:27 — “So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ____, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.”
kids.explain: Genesis 2:7 — “And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an ____ meet for him.”
kids.explain: Genesis 2:18 — “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And I will put enmity between thee and the ____, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.”
kids.explain: Genesis 3:15 — “And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy ____? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?”
kids.explain: Genesis 4:9 — “And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But Noah found ____ in the eyes of the LORD.”
kids.explain: Genesis 6:8 — “But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the rain was upon the ____ forty days and forty nights.”
kids.explain: Genesis 7:12 — “And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a ____ between me and the earth.”
kids.explain: Genesis 9:13 — “I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's ____, unto a land that I will shew thee:”
kids.explain: Genesis 12:1 — “Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a ____:”
kids.explain: Genesis 12:2 — “And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he ____ in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.”
kids.explain: Genesis 15:6 — “And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of ____, and Sarah shall have a son.”
kids.explain: Genesis 18:14 — “Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt ____: so they went both of them together.”
kids.explain: Genesis 22:8 — “And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to ____: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.”
kids.explain: Genesis 28:12 — “And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou ____ with God and with men, and hast prevailed.”
kids.explain: Genesis 32:28 — “And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his ____, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.”
kids.explain: Genesis 37:3 — “Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much ____ alive.”
kids.explain: Genesis 50:20 — “But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ____.”
kids.explain: Exodus 3:5 — “And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the ____ of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.”
kids.explain: Exodus 3:14 — “And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your ____.”
kids.explain: Exodus 14:14 — “The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Honour thy ____ and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.”
kids.explain: Exodus 20:12 — “Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee ____.”
kids.explain: Exodus 33:14 — “And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy ____, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.”
kids.explain: Leviticus 19:18 — “Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The LORD ____ thee, and keep thee:”
kids.explain: Numbers 6:24 — “The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be ____ unto thee:”
kids.explain: Numbers 6:25 — “The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee ____.”
kids.explain: Numbers 6:26 — “The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For the LORD thy God is a consuming ____, even a jealous God.”
kids.explain: Deuteronomy 4:24 — “For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine ____, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.”
kids.explain: Deuteronomy 6:5 — “And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of ____, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.”
kids.explain: Deuteronomy 4:11 — “And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Have not I commanded thee? Be ____ and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.”
kids.explain: Joshua 1:9 — “Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty ____ of valour.”
kids.explain: Judges 6:12 — “And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy ____ heareth.”
kids.explain: 1 Samuel 3:10 — “And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the ____ is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.”
kids.explain: 1 Samuel 17:47 — “And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my ____, and my deliverer;”
kids.explain: 2 Samuel 22:2 — “And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt ____, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.”
kids.explain: 1 Kings 18:38 — “Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small ____.”
kids.explain: 1 Kings 19:12 — “And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he answered, ____ not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.”
kids.explain: 2 Kings 6:16 — “And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the ____:”
kids.explain: Job 19:25 — “For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his ____: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.”
kids.explain: Job 42:10 — “And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed is the man that walketh not in the ____ of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.”
kids.explain: Psalm 1:1 — “Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 1:2 — “But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The heavens declare the ____ of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.”
kids.explain: Psalm 19:1 — “The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my ____, and my redeemer.”
kids.explain: Psalm 19:14 — “Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The LORD is my ____; I shall not want.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:1 — “The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:2 — “He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He restoreth my ____: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:3 — “He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they ____ me.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:4 — “Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Thou preparest a ____ before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:5 — “Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Surely ____ and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:6 — “Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the ____, and they that dwell therein.”
kids.explain: Psalm 24:1 — “The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The LORD is my light and my ____; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?”
kids.explain: Psalm 27:1 — “The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 30:5 — “For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the ____ that trusteth in him.”
kids.explain: Psalm 34:8 — “O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Many are the afflictions of the ____: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.”
kids.explain: Psalm 34:19 — “Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 37:4 — “Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 37:25 — “I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 46:10 — “Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right ____ within me.”
kids.explain: Psalm 51:10 — “Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the ____ to be moved.”
kids.explain: Psalm 55:22 — “Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For the LORD God is a sun and ____: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.”
kids.explain: Psalm 84:11 — “For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 90:12 — “So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the ____ of the Almighty.”
kids.explain: Psalm 91:1 — “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my ____: my God; in him will I trust.”
kids.explain: Psalm 91:2 — “I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right ____; but it shall not come nigh thee.”
kids.explain: Psalm 91:7 — “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For he shall give his ____ charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.”
kids.explain: Psalm 91:11 — “For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with ____: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.”
kids.explain: Psalm 100:4 — “Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Bless the LORD, O my ____: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.”
kids.explain: Psalm 103:1 — “Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Bless the LORD, O my ____, and forget not all his benefits:”
kids.explain: Psalm 103:2 — “Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He sent his ____, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.”
kids.explain: Psalm 107:20 — “He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “This is the ____ which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.”
kids.explain: Psalm 118:24 — “This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Thy word have I hid in mine ____, that I might not sin against thee.”
kids.explain: Psalm 119:11 — “Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a ____ unto my path.”
kids.explain: Psalm 119:105 — “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 121:1 — “I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “My help cometh from the LORD, which made ____ and earth.”
kids.explain: Psalm 121:2 — “My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “They that sow in tears shall reap in ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 126:5 — “They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for ____ to dwell together in unity!”
kids.explain: Psalm 133:1 — “Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I will ____ thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.”
kids.explain: Psalm 139:14 — “I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Let every thing that hath ____ praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.”
kids.explain: Psalm 150:6 — “Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Trust in the LORD with all thine ____; and lean not unto thine own understanding.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 3:5 — “Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy ____.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 3:6 — “In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Keep thy ____ with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 4:23 — “Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the ____ of the holy is understanding.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 9:10 — “The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “A soft answer turneth away ____: but grievous words stir up anger.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 15:1 — “A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy ____ shall be established.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 16:3 — “Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty ____ before a fall.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 16:18 — “Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The name of the LORD is a strong ____: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 18:10 — “The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Death and life are in the power of the ____: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 18:21 — “Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Train up a ____ in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 22:6 — “Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his ____.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 27:17 — “Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Where there is no ____, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 29:18 — “Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Who can find a virtuous ____? for her price is far above rubies.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 31:10 — “Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the ____:”
kids.explain: Ecclesiastes 3:1 — “To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: ____ God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.”
kids.explain: Ecclesiastes 12:13 — “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Also I heard the ____ of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 6:8 — “Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a ____; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 7:14 — “Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Thou wilt keep him in perfect ____, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 26:3 — “Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the ____ of our God shall stand for ever.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 40:8 — “The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth ____.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 40:29 — “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the ____, and rivers in the desert.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 43:19 — “Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our ____ was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 53:5 — “But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the ____ of the LORD is risen upon thee.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 60:1 — “Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the ____.”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 1:5 — “Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose ____ the LORD is.”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 17:7 — “Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Is not my ____ like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 23:29 — “Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of ____, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 29:11 — “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all ____: is there any thing too hard for me?”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 32:27 — “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and ____ things, which thou knowest not.”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 33:3 — “Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “It is of the LORD'S ____ that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.”
kids.explain: Lamentations 3:22 — “It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “They are new every ____: great is thy faithfulness.”
kids.explain: Lamentations 3:23 — “They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the ____ of the LORD.”
kids.explain: Ezekiel 37:4 — “Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O ____.”
kids.explain: Daniel 3:17 — “If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And such as do wickedly against the ____ shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.”
kids.explain: Daniel 11:32 — “And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be ____; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.”
kids.explain: Obadiah 1:17 — “But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love ____, and to walk humbly with thy God?”
kids.explain: Micah 6:8 — “He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the ____, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.”
kids.explain: Habakkuk 2:2 — “And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the ____ of God.”
kids.explain: Matthew 4:4 — “But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he saith unto them, ____ me, and I will make you fishers of men.”
kids.explain: Matthew 4:19 — “And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed are the poor in spirit: for their's is the ____ of heaven.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:3 — “Blessed are the poor in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed are the pure in ____: for they shall see God.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:8 — “Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the ____ of God.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:9 — “Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Ye are the light of the ____. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:14 — “Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in ____.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:16 — “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But I say unto you, ____ your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:44 — “But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in ____, Hallowed be thy name.”
kids.explain: Matthew 6:9 — “After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But seek ye first the ____ of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.”
kids.explain: Matthew 6:33 — “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the ____ is the evil thereof.”
kids.explain: Matthew 6:34 — “Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be ____ unto you:”
kids.explain: Matthew 7:7 — “Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the ____ and the prophets.”
kids.explain: Matthew 7:12 — “Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Come unto me, all ye that ____ and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.”
kids.explain: Matthew 11:28 — “Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this ____ I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.”
kids.explain: Matthew 16:18 — “And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For where two or three are gathered together in my ____, there am I in the midst of them.”
kids.explain: Matthew 18:20 — “For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy ____, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.”
kids.explain: Matthew 22:37 — “Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Heaven and ____ shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.”
kids.explain: Matthew 24:35 — “Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the ____, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:”
kids.explain: Matthew 28:19 — “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the ____. Amen.”
kids.explain: Matthew 28:20 — “Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that ____.”
kids.explain: Mark 9:23 — “Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, ____ that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.”
kids.explain: Mark 11:24 — “Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he said unto them, Go ye into all the ____, and preach the gospel to every creature.”
kids.explain: Mark 16:15 — “And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my ____ shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;”
kids.explain: Mark 16:17 — “And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all ____.”
kids.explain: Luke 2:10 — “And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For unto you is born this day in the ____ of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.”
kids.explain: Luke 2:11 — “For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth ____, good will toward men.”
kids.explain: Luke 2:14 — “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the ____: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.”
kids.explain: Luke 10:19 — “Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in ____ over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.”
kids.explain: Luke 15:7 — “I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For the Son of ____ is come to seek and to save that which was lost.”
kids.explain: Luke 19:10 — “For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But as many as received him, to them gave he ____ to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:”
kids.explain: John 1:12 — “But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the ____,) full of grace and truth.”
kids.explain: John 1:14 — “And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the ____ of God.”
kids.explain: John 3:3 — “Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For God so loved the ____, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.”
kids.explain: John 3:16 — “For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in ____.”
kids.explain: John 4:24 — “God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never ____; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.”
kids.explain: John 6:35 — “And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the ____: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.”
kids.explain: John 8:12 — “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you ____.”
kids.explain: John 8:32 — “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “If the ____ therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.”
kids.explain: John 8:36 — “If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have ____, and that they might have it more abundantly.”
kids.explain: John 10:10 — “The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the ____.”
kids.explain: John 10:11 — “I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the ____: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:”
kids.explain: John 11:25 — “Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “A ____ commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.”
kids.explain: John 13:34 — “A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Let not your ____ be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.”
kids.explain: John 14:1 — “Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “In my Father's ____ are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.”
kids.explain: John 14:2 — “In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the ____, but by me.”
kids.explain: John 14:6 — “Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “If ye shall ask any thing in my ____, I will do it.”
kids.explain: John 14:14 — “If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your ____ be troubled, neither let it be afraid.”
kids.explain: John 14:27 — “Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much ____: for without me ye can do nothing.”
kids.explain: John 15:5 — “I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his ____ for his friends.”
kids.explain: John 15:13 — “Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have ____. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.”
kids.explain: John 16:33 — “These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy ____ is truth.”
kids.explain: John 17:17 — “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: ____ are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.”
kids.explain: John 20:29 — “Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the ____ gave them utterance.”
