kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he ____, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.”
kids.explain: 2 Kings 6:16 — “And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter ____ upon the earth:”
kids.explain: Job 19:25 — “For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he ____ for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.”
kids.explain: Job 42:10 — “And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the ____ of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.”
kids.explain: Psalm 1:1 — “Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate ____ and night.”
kids.explain: Psalm 1:2 — “But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The ____ declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.”
kids.explain: Psalm 19:1 — “The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my ____, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.”
kids.explain: Psalm 19:14 — “Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he ____ me beside the still waters.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:2 — “He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the ____ of righteousness for his name's sake.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:3 — “He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Yea, though I walk through the valley of the ____ of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:4 — “Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my ____ runneth over.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:5 — “Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Surely goodness and ____ shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.”
kids.explain: Psalm 23:6 — “Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The ____ is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.”
kids.explain: Psalm 24:1 — “The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the ____ of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?”
kids.explain: Psalm 27:1 — “The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For his anger endureth but a moment; in his ____ is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.”
kids.explain: Psalm 30:5 — “For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that ____ in him.”
kids.explain: Psalm 34:8 — “O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD ____ him out of them all.”
kids.explain: Psalm 34:19 — “Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall ____ thee the desires of thine heart.”
kids.explain: Psalm 37:4 — “Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his ____ begging bread.”
kids.explain: Psalm 37:25 — “I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Be still, and ____ that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.”
kids.explain: Psalm 46:10 — “Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Create in me a clean ____, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.”
kids.explain: Psalm 51:10 — “Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give ____ and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.”
kids.explain: Psalm 84:11 — “For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “So teach us to number our ____, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.”
kids.explain: Psalm 90:12 — “So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He that ____ in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.”
kids.explain: Psalm 91:1 — “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I will say of the LORD, He is my ____ and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”
kids.explain: Psalm 91:2 — “I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not ____ nigh thee.”
kids.explain: Psalm 91:7 — “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 91:11 — “For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 100:4 — “Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 103:1 — “Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He sent his word, and healed them, and ____ them from their destructions.”
kids.explain: Psalm 107:20 — “He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “This is the day which the LORD ____ made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.”
kids.explain: Psalm 118:24 — “This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Thy ____ have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.”
kids.explain: Psalm 119:11 — “Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Thy ____ is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.”
kids.explain: Psalm 119:105 — “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I will lift up mine eyes unto the ____, from whence cometh my help.”
kids.explain: Psalm 121:1 — “I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and ____.”
kids.explain: Psalm 121:2 — “My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “They that sow in ____ shall reap in joy.”
kids.explain: Psalm 126:5 — “They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Behold, how ____ and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!”
kids.explain: Psalm 133:1 — “Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my ____ knoweth right well.”
kids.explain: Psalm 139:14 — “I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Let every thing that ____ breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.”
kids.explain: Psalm 150:6 — “Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “In all thy ____ acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 3:6 — “In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of ____.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 4:23 — “Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The fear of the LORD is the beginning of ____: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 9:10 — “The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up ____.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 15:1 — “A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Commit thy ____ unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 16:3 — “Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Pride ____ before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 16:18 — “Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The ____ of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 18:10 — “The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the ____ thereof.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 18:21 — “Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Train up a child in the ____ he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 22:6 — “Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Iron sharpeneth iron; so a ____ sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 27:17 — “Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Where there is no vision, the ____ perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.”
kids.explain: Proverbs 29:18 — “Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of ____.”
kids.explain: Ecclesiastes 12:13 — “Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Also I ____ the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 6:8 — “Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his ____ Immanuel.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 7:14 — “Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Thou wilt keep him in ____ peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 26:3 — “Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall ____ for ever.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 40:8 — “The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He giveth ____ to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 40:29 — “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the ____.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 43:19 — “Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our ____: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 53:5 — “But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Arise, shine; for thy ____ is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.”
kids.explain: Isaiah 60:1 — “Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed is the ____ that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 17:7 — “Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Is not my word like as a ____? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 23:29 — “Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of ____, to give you an expected end.”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 29:11 — “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee ____ and mighty things, which thou knowest not.”
kids.explain: Jeremiah 33:3 — “Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “They are new every morning: ____ is thy faithfulness.”
kids.explain: Lamentations 3:23 — “They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, ____ the word of the LORD.”
kids.explain: Ezekiel 37:4 — “Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine ____, O king.”
kids.explain: Daniel 3:17 — “If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the ____ that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.”
kids.explain: Daniel 11:32 — “And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the ____ of Jacob shall possess their possessions.”
kids.explain: Obadiah 1:17 — “But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to ____ mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?”
kids.explain: Micah 6:8 — “He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD ____ me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.”
kids.explain: Habakkuk 2:2 — “And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by ____ alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.”
kids.explain: Matthew 4:4 — “But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed are the poor in ____: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:3 — “Blessed are the poor in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed are the ____ in heart: for they shall see God.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:8 — “Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be ____ the children of God.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:9 — “Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Ye are the ____ of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:14 — “Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your ____ which is in heaven.”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:16 — “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But I say unto you, Love your ____, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;”
kids.explain: Matthew 5:44 — “But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “After this manner therefore pray ye: Our ____ which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.”
kids.explain: Matthew 6:9 — “After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But ____ ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.”
kids.explain: Matthew 6:33 — “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the ____ thereof.”
kids.explain: Matthew 6:34 — “Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Ask, and it shall be given you; ____, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:”
kids.explain: Matthew 7:7 — “Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you ____.”
kids.explain: Matthew 11:28 — “Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the ____ of hell shall not prevail against it.”
kids.explain: Matthew 16:18 — “And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy ____, and with all thy mind.”
kids.explain: Matthew 22:37 — “Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my ____ shall not pass away.”
kids.explain: Matthew 24:35 — “Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the ____ of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:”
kids.explain: Matthew 28:19 — “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus said unto him, If thou canst ____, all things are possible to him that believeth.”
kids.explain: Mark 9:23 — “Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye ____ them, and ye shall have them.”
kids.explain: Mark 11:24 — “Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he said unto them, ____ ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.”
kids.explain: Mark 16:15 — “And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with ____ tongues;”
kids.explain: Mark 16:17 — “And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the angel said unto them, ____ not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.”
kids.explain: Luke 2:10 — “And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For unto you is born this ____ in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.”
kids.explain: Luke 2:11 — “For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Glory to God in the highest, and on ____ peace, good will toward men.”
kids.explain: Luke 2:14 — “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Behold, I ____ unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.”
kids.explain: Luke 10:19 — “Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I say unto you, that likewise ____ shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.”
kids.explain: Luke 15:7 — “I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For the ____ of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.”
kids.explain: Luke 19:10 — “For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his ____:”
kids.explain: John 1:12 — “But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of ____ and truth.”
kids.explain: John 1:14 — “And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a ____ be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”
kids.explain: John 3:3 — “Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting ____.”
kids.explain: John 3:16 — “For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never ____.”
kids.explain: John 6:35 — “And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of ____.”
kids.explain: John 8:12 — “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And ye shall ____ the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”
kids.explain: John 8:32 — “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “The thief ____ not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.”
kids.explain: John 10:10 — “The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his ____ for the sheep.”
kids.explain: John 10:11 — “I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that ____ in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:”
kids.explain: John 11:25 — “Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have ____ you, that ye also love one another.”
kids.explain: John 13:34 — “A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I ____ to prepare a place for you.”
kids.explain: John 14:2 — “In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the ____, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.”
kids.explain: John 14:6 — “Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “If ye shall ____ any thing in my name, I will do it.”
kids.explain: John 14:14 — “If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the ____ giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.”
kids.explain: John 14:27 — “Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I am the ____, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.”
kids.explain: John 15:5 — “I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Greater ____ hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.”
kids.explain: John 15:13 — “Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of ____ cheer; I have overcome the world.”
kids.explain: John 16:33 — “These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And they were all filled with the ____ Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.”
kids.explain: Acts 2:4 — “And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Then Peter said, Silver and ____ have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.”
kids.explain: Acts 3:6 — “Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under ____ given among men, whereby we must be saved.”
kids.explain: Acts 4:12 — “Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be ____, and thy house.”
kids.explain: Acts 16:31 — “And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For all have sinned, and ____ short of the glory of God;”
kids.explain: Romans 3:23 — “For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ ____ for us.”
kids.explain: Romans 5:8 — “But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal ____ through Jesus Christ our Lord.”
kids.explain: Romans 6:23 — “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the ____, but after the Spirit.”
kids.explain: Romans 8:1 — “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And we know that all things work together for good to them that ____ God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.”
kids.explain: Romans 8:28 — “And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “That if thou shalt confess with thy ____ the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.”
kids.explain: Romans 10:9 — “That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the ____ of God.”
kids.explain: Romans 10:17 — “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I beseech you therefore, ____, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.”
kids.explain: Romans 12:1 — “I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and ____, will of God.”
kids.explain: Romans 12:2 — “And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and ____ in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.”
kids.explain: Romans 15:13 — “Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that ____ him.”
kids.explain: 1 Corinthians 2:9 — “But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And now abideth faith, ____, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.”
kids.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:13 — “And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But thanks be to God, which ____ us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.”
kids.explain: 1 Corinthians 15:57 — “But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the ____ of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.”
kids.explain: 1 Corinthians 15:58 — “Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be ____.”
kids.explain: 1 Corinthians 16:13 — “Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “(For we ____ by faith, not by sight:)”
kids.explain: 2 Corinthians 5:7 — “(For we walk by faith, not by sight:)”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: ____ things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.”
kids.explain: 2 Corinthians 5:17 — “Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Every ____ according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.”
kids.explain: 2 Corinthians 9:7 — “Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, ____, faith,”
kids.explain: Galatians 5:22 — “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For by ____ are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:”
kids.explain: Ephesians 2:8 — “For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that ____ in us,”
kids.explain: Ephesians 3:20 — “Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake ____ forgiven you.”
kids.explain: Ephesians 4:32 — “And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Finally, my ____, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.”
kids.explain: Ephesians 6:10 — “Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to ____ against the wiles of the devil.”
kids.explain: Ephesians 6:11 — “Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For we wrestle not against flesh and ____, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.”
kids.explain: Ephesians 6:12 — “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the ____ of Jesus Christ:”
kids.explain: Philippians 1:6 — “Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For to me to live is Christ, and to ____ is gain.”
kids.explain: Philippians 1:21 — “For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “That at the ____ of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;”
kids.explain: Philippians 2:10 — “That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be ____ known unto God.”
kids.explain: Philippians 4:6 — “Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall ____ your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.”
kids.explain: Philippians 4:7 — “And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in ____ by Christ Jesus.”
kids.explain: Philippians 4:19 — “But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of ____, and of love, and of a sound mind.”
kids.explain: 2 Timothy 1:7 — “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the ____ of truth.”
kids.explain: 2 Timothy 2:15 — “Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I have fought a ____ fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:”
kids.explain: 2 Timothy 4:7 — “I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that ____ to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.”
kids.explain: Hebrews 11:6 — “But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that ____ to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.”
kids.explain: James 1:5 — “If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the ____ of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.”
kids.explain: James 1:17 — “Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous ____ availeth much.”
kids.explain: James 5:16 — “Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, ____ about, seeking whom he may devour:”
kids.explain: 1 Peter 5:8 — “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and ____ to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.”
kids.explain: 1 John 1:9 — “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Ye are of God, little ____, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.”
kids.explain: 1 John 4:4 — “Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “He that loveth not ____ not God; for God is love.”
kids.explain: 1 John 4:8 — “He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear ____ torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.”
kids.explain: 1 John 4:18 — “There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the ____.”
kids.explain: Revelation 12:11 — “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “In the beginning God ____ the heaven and the earth.”
kids.explain: Genesis 1:1 — “In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD God formed man of the ____ of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.”
kids.explain: Genesis 2:7 — “And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the LORD God said, It is not ____ that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.”
kids.explain: Genesis 2:18 — “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And the rain was upon the earth forty ____ and forty nights.”
kids.explain: Genesis 7:12 — “And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “I do set my bow in the ____, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.”
kids.explain: Genesis 9:13 — “I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy ____ great; and thou shalt be a blessing:”
kids.explain: Genesis 12:2 — “And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will ____ unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.”
kids.explain: Genesis 18:14 — “Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And Abraham said, My ____, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.”
kids.explain: Genesis 22:8 — “And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.”

kids.q: Finish the verse: “And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the ____ of God ascending and descending on it.”
kids.explain: Genesis 28:12 — “And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.”
